license_required.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person: (1) To practice or to offer to practice professional nursing in this state; ... unless such person has been duly licensed under the provisions of this act.

degree_required.value: Graduation from an approved school of professional nursing
degree_required.quote: Have graduated from an approved school of professional nursing in the United States or its territories or from a school of professional nursing in a foreign country which is approved by the board

accrediting_body.value: Board of Nursing (or board-recognized national nursing accreditation agency)
accrediting_body.quote: The board may accept nationally accredited schools of nursing as defined in rule and regulation.

required.quote: The board shall issue a license to an applicant to practice as a registered professional nurse who has: (A) Met the qualifications set forth in subsections (a) and (b); (B) passed a written examination as prescribed by the board

exams.name: NCLEX-RN (written examination as prescribed by the board)
exams.notes: Persons who do not take the licensure examination within 24 months after graduation must petition the board for permission.
exams.quote: passed a written examination as prescribed by the board

exams.name: NCLEX-PN (written examination as prescribed by the board)
exams.quote: passed a written examination as prescribed by the board

interval_years.quote: All licenses issued under the provisions of this act, whether initial or renewal, including multi-state licenses under the nurse licensure compact, shall expire every two years.

required.quote: every licensee with an active nursing license shall submit with the renewal application evidence of satisfactory completion of a program of continuing nursing education required by the board

period_years.quote: All licenses issued under the provisions of this act, whether initial or renewal, including multi-state licenses under the nurse licensure compact, shall expire every two years.

available.quote: The board may issue a license to practice nursing as a registered professional nurse to an applicant who has been duly licensed as a registered professional nurse by examination under the laws of another state or territory if, in the opinion of the board, the applicant meets the qualifications required of a registered professional in this state.

requirements.value: Applicant must meet Kansas qualifications; verification of licensure status required from original state of licensure.
requirements.quote: Verification of the applicant's licensure status shall be required from the original state of licensure.

regulatory_model.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person: (1) To practice or to offer to practice professional nursing in this state; ... unless such person has been duly licensed under the provisions of this act.

credential_type.quote: The board shall issue a license to an applicant to practice as a registered professional nurse

is_mandatory.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person: (1) To practice or to offer to practice professional nursing in this state; ... unless such person has been duly licensed under the provisions of this act.

title_protection.quote: No other person shall assume the title or use the abbreviation or any other words, letters, signs or figures to indicate that the person is a registered professional nurse.

scope_protection.quote: to practice professional nursing, practical nursing or practice as an advanced practice registered nurse, unless duly licensed to do so

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of fraud or deceit in practicing nursing or in procuring or attempting to procure a license to practice nursing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To be guilty of fraud or deceit in practicing nursing or in procuring or attempting to procure a license to practice nursing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of a felony or a misdemeanor involving an illegal drug offense, unless sufficient rehabilitation is established.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: to have been guilty of a felony or to have been guilty of a misdemeanor involving an illegal drug offense unless the applicant or licensee establishes sufficient rehabilitation to warrant the public trust

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted or found guilty or entered into an agreed disposition of a misdemeanor offense related to the practice of nursing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has been convicted or found guilty or has entered into an agreed disposition of a misdemeanor offense related to the practice of nursing as determined on a case-by-case basis

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed an act of professional incompetency, including gross negligence, repeated ordinary negligence, or a pattern of incompetence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: to have committed an act of professional incompetency as defined in subsection (e)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unable to practice with skill and safety due to current abuse of drugs or alcohol.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: to be unable to practice with skill and safety due to current abuse of drugs or alcohol

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudged in need of a guardian or conservator and not restored to capacity.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: to be a person who has been adjudged in need of a guardian or conservator, or both, under the act for obtaining a guardian or conservator, or both, and who has not been restored to capacity under that act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of unprofessional conduct as defined by rules and regulations of the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: to be guilty of unprofessional conduct as defined by rules and regulations of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or repeatedly violated the provisions of the Kansas nurse practice act or any rules and regulations adopted pursuant to that act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: to have willfully or repeatedly violated the provisions of the Kansas nurse practice act or any rules and regulations adopted pursuant to that act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had a license denied, revoked, limited, suspended, or other disciplinary action taken by a licensing authority of another state, U.S. government agency, territory, or country.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: to have a license to practice nursing as a registered nurse or as a practical nurse denied, revoked, limited or suspended, or to be publicly or privately censured, by a licensing authority of another state, agency of the United States government, territory of the United States or country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assisted suicide in violation of Kansas law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: to have assisted suicide in violation of K.S.A. 21-3406, prior to its repeal, or K.S.A. 21-5407, and amendments thereto

definition_quote.value: The practice of professional nursing as performed by a registered professional nurse for compensation or gratuitously means the process in which substantial specialized knowledge derived from the biological, physical, and behavioral sciences is applied to: the care, diagnosis, treatment, counsel and health teaching of persons who are experiencing changes in the normal health processes or who require assistance in the maintenance of health or the prevention or management of illness, injury or infirmity; administration, supervision or teaching of the process as defined in this section; and the execution of the medical regimen as prescribed by a person licensed to practice medicine and surgery or a person licensed to practice dentistry.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of professional nursing as performed by a registered professional nurse for compensation or gratuitously ... means the process in which substantial specialized knowledge derived from the biological, physical, and behavioral sciences is applied to: the care, diagnosis, treatment, counsel and health teaching of persons who are experiencing changes in the normal health processes

methods_authorized.quote: the care, diagnosis, treatment, counsel and health teaching of persons who are experiencing changes in the normal health processes or who require assistance in the maintenance of health or the prevention or management of illness, injury or infirmity; administration, supervision or teaching of the process as defined in this section; and the execution of the medical regimen as prescribed by a person licensed to practice medicine and surgery or a person licensed to practice dentistry.

drug_authority.value: APRNs may prescribe, procure and administer any drug consistent with their specific role and population focus, except drugs intended to cause an abortion; controlled substances must be prescribed in accordance with the uniform controlled substances act and require DEA registration.
drug_authority.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse may prescribe durable medical equipment and prescribe, procure and administer any drug consistent with such licensee's specific role and population focus, except an advanced practice registered nurse shall not prescribe any drug that is intended to cause an abortion.

license_tiers.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" or "APRN" means a professional nurse who holds a license from the board to function as a professional nurse in an advanced role

aprn_role_categories.quote: The board shall adopt rules and regulations consistent with the Kansas nurse practice act applicable to advanced practice registered nurses that: (1) Establish roles and identify titles and abbreviations of advanced practice registered nurses that are consistent with nursing practice specialties recognized by the nursing profession.

value: person licensed to practice medicine and surgery
lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: tasks and responsibilities ... which tasks and responsibilities are based on acceptable educational preparation within the framework of supportive and restorative care under the direction of a registered professional nurse, a person licensed to practice medicine and surgery or a person licensed to practice dentistry.

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: The board shall establish standards and requirements for any professional nurse who desires to obtain licensure as an advanced practice registered nurse.

full_independent_practice_available.quote: No professional nurse shall announce or represent to the public that such person is an advanced practice registered nurse unless such professional nurse has complied with requirements established by the board and holds a valid license as an advanced practice registered nurse

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse may prescribe durable medical equipment and prescribe, procure and administer any drug consistent with such licensee's specific role and population focus

dea_registration_required.quote: In order to prescribe controlled substances, the advanced practice registered nurse shall: (A) Register with the federal drug enforcement administration

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: the administration of medications to residents of adult care homes or to patients in hospital-based long-term care units ... by an unlicensed person who has been certified as having satisfactorily completed a training program in medication administration approved by the secretary of health and environment

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: All nursing procedures, including but not limited to administration of medication, delegated by a licensed nurse to a designated unlicensed person shall be supervised.

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: This section shall be known and may be cited as the nurse licensure compact.

multistate_license_option_available.quote: Any licensed nurse may file a multi-state license application together with the prescribed multi-state license fee at any time the nurse holds an active license.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: "Alternative program" means a nondisciplinary monitoring program approved by a licensing board.

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: A registered nurse anesthetist shall perform duties and functions in an interdependent role as a member of a physician or dentist directed health care team.

cnm_out_of_hospital_birth_authorized.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse certified in the role of certified nurse-midwife and engaging in the independent practice of midwifery under the independent practice of midwifery act

aprn_formulary_or_protocol_required.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse may prescribe durable medical equipment and prescribe, procure and administer any drug consistent with such licensee's specific role and population focus

military_education_credit_required.quote: The board may authorize the educational requirement under subsection (a)(1) to be waived for an applicant who has attained a passing score on the national council licensure examination for practical nurses and provided evidence to the board of such applicant's practical nursing experience during a period of active service as a member of the armed forces.
